description: This file declares a factory function for creating a command handler related to device power button commands, part of the Cuttlefish Android emulator project. It includes necessary headers and defines a function returning a unique pointer to a CvdCommandHandler, taking an InstanceManager reference as parameter.

methods.name: NewCvdDevicePowerBtnCommandHandler
methods.description: Creates and returns a unique pointer to a CvdCommandHandler for device power button commands, utilizing an InstanceManager.
